method: Read-only code and test-source review; no product edits, runtime execution, test execution, server startup or deployment by reviewer.
reviewScope: Sequential weighted sampling without replacement removes each selected candidate and its weight together.
Default card weight 5 and owned-passive weight 9 combine multiplicatively with the rune role factor 4; jointly favored Q/W/E/R cards weigh 36, equivalent to 7.2 times baseline.
Red Fighter/Marksman, blue Tank/Fighter, purple Mage/Assassin and green Tank/Support mapping; multiple matching roles apply the multiplier once.
Official 91-subject role catalogue; NPCs and non-subject basic/weapon/tactical cards do not receive role weighting.
Starting passive/card offers and actual wildlife random card rewards use the weighted paths; authored subject/boss/encounter rewards remain fixed.
Preparation selections and card slots survive rune changes; stored per-roll seeds prevent color round trips or same-color main/support changes from creating free rerolls.
Legacy load and same-passive reselect preserve displayed offers and RNG; explicit rune color change or paid reroll opts into new weighting.
New sampling calls are confined to initial offers, explicit offer changes and wildlife reward generation; loading, enemy intent and combat hand shuffling introduce no new role sampler calls.
New test sources cover expected 80/20 and 7.2/8.2 distributions, unique offers, save/seed/selection round trips, legacy opt-in, wildlife integration and fixed-reward/combat-shuffle boundaries.

resolvedFinding.issue: A support rune from another color could display that color role weighting as if active while actual weighting follows the main rune.
resolvedFinding.resolution: Implementation owner changed support-rune detail text to state that only the current main rune color contributes role weighting and the inspected support rune adds no independent role modifier.

assessment: No unresolved blocking issues found within this read-only review scope. Runtime and statistical test execution are separate evidence owned by the parent and implementation agent.
